the use of the modified polyamide 6 (cPA-SMA) as a film blowing material would not only be a good way of recycling the waste maleic anhyrdide polyamide 6, but it would also be an effective way of improving the mechanical properties and the thermal stability of the polyamide 6.

polyamide 6 nanocomposites can be prepared with high exfoliation degree, and the mechanical properties of these materials can be improved by the addition of clay.
polyamide clay nanomaterials have been successfully synthesized, and the nanocomposites have been blended with low density polythene (LDPE).
the use of polyamide 6/clay nanocomposite and recycled polyamide 6 as film blowing material is feasible.
